content: "Wow, you finally did *something*—too bad it’s the bare minimum with the enthusiasm of a deflated balloon. Did you get a participation trophy for that? Next time, aim higher… or just don’t, your standards are already in the gutter. *"[your answer]"*—said no one impressed."
